## B. Fits on zeta-corrected LS term energies (unit weights; A, B, C, α, β, T1, T2)

| space | virtual l dropped | largest block | T1 | T2 | T2 vs Step 8 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| famnsph | sph | 23751 | 12.4191 | 1.6682 | -2.7 % |
| famnsphg | sphg | 12654 | 15.8629 | 2.2147 | +29.2 % |

### A1. Job-A class: configurations and double counting

Class = the 25 configurations 3s¹3p⁴3d⁶, 3s¹3p⁴3d⁵ v (3), 3s¹3p⁴3d⁴ v v′ (21) (same list for Cr³⁺ and V²⁺, V = the k1fh virtuals). 3s¹3p⁴3d⁶ is one of the three pure n = 3 configurations (Step 10, k1fh_n3); the other 24 are all in the Table S1 hole remainder (u3c1 − k1fh_n3, 60 configurations; the remaining 36 are 3s⁰3p⁵ 3d⁵ v, 3s⁰3p⁵3d⁴ v v′, the 4-hole 3s⁰3p⁴3d⁶ v, 3s¹3p³3d⁶ v, 3s²3p²3d⁶ v, and 3s²3p³3d⁵ v). No job-A configuration is outside Step 10 + the hole item: the class is already counted once in the paper.
